items.title: AIRCAIRO places order for 15 Airbus A320neo aircraft
items.summary: AIRCAIRO, Egypt’s National growing Air-carrier, has signed a firm order for 15 Airbus A320neo aircraft at the El Alamein International Airshow 2026.
